card.name: Table column headings and dosing terms
card.fires_on: A word or word-part that is the last piece of a heading or term just before the next data item, often in dosing tables or drug-interaction text. Examples are Baseline, Opioid, WBC, and theophylline.

modes.label: Table headers
modes.description: The end of a column heading in a dosing table, just before the values.

modes.label: Ends of drug or lab names
modes.description: The final piece of a drug or lab term, just before a verb or noun such as infusion or concentration.

modes.label: Word before a clause break
modes.description: A word that ends a short phrase and is followed by a comma or a new clause.
